notes: Refined existing stories for clarity, contract alignment, and frontend-backend boundary correctness. No new stories created per dedup rules.

change_log.value: Clarified strict alignment with provider_search_service output including lat/long availability assumptions and null-handling rules.
change_log.note: Tighten schema contract to avoid map rendering gaps

change_log.value: Expanded to include coordinate normalization and fallback handling for missing geo fields.
Clarified reusable component boundaries and optional clustering behavior based on result density.
Added explicit binding to chat-driven provider search lifecycle and state updates.
Expanded to include synchronization validation between chat results and map markers.

stories.title: Define Map Provider Data Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and document the frontend data contract for map rendering including lat/long, provider_id, name, specialty, and optional metadata (address, distance). Ensure strict alignment with provider_search_service outputs, including handling of missing or null coordinates and validation rules.

stories.title: Implement Provider-to-Map Transformation Logic
stories.description: Implement transformation layer converting provider search results into map marker objects, including coordinate validation, normalization, null filtering, fallback handling for missing geo fields, and deduplication based on provider_id.

stories.title: Build Interactive Map Component
stories.description: Develop reusable frontend map component supporting marker rendering, optional clustering based on density, zoom/pan controls, and click interactions displaying provider summary card. Component must be modular and reusable across provider experiences.

stories.title: Bind Map to Live Provider Search Results
stories.description: Integrate map component with live provider search flow so markers update dynamically based on chat-driven queries, filters, and location context. Ensure synchronization with frontend state management in the conversational UI.

stories.title: Map Rendering and Interaction Test Suite
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering marker rendering accuracy, coordinate edge cases, clustering behavior, user interactions (click, zoom), and synchronization between provider search results and map markers.
